valores.label: Southern Pacific begins the pier at Santa Monica (by Willard's account)

legenda: 1891: the Southern Pacific begins its pier at Santa Monica, by Willard's account.
texto_para_tela: (sem número; card 'Secretary, Los Angeles Chamber of Commerce (1891)')
nota: Fonte de parte (Willard era do lado de San Pedro); a voz atribui ('by the account of Charles Willard').
narracao: The railroad went to the other bay, Santa Monica. In 1891, the Southern Pacific began a pier there, by the account of Charles Willard, a Chamber of Commerce man on San Pedro's side.
